coverage_note: The current database contains Scolytinae records only. Platypodinae is part of the long-term project scope but has not yet been integrated into the database.
geographic_scope: China checklist, including separately tracked Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao occurrence assessments where available.
profile_count_status: 577 source-supported China Scolytinae taxon profiles through VSN_6555; VSN_6345 (Xyleborus rufobrunneus Eggers, 1929) is retained in the Notion taxonomic backbone as Excluded from the China checklist following authorship-based correction of historical Xyleborus similis records to VSN_2732 (Euwallacea similis). VSN_4713 also remains excluded from the website.
